# AGENTS.md — GitHub Actions

Automatic pull-request and `master` checks must use GitHub-hosted runners, require no repository secrets, and validate only the community repository's supported paths. Keep inherited DeepSeek infrastructure matrices manual-only. Package workflows may build, pack, install, and upload short-lived artifacts, but this repository publishes source releases on GitHub and must not retain npm or PyPI publication credentials or jobs. Real-provider and external-sandbox workflows remain manual and must fail clearly when their explicit secret is absent. See the [community source-release decision](../.agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-09-07-community-source-release-boundary.md).
